slip.document:
# Riverbend Memorial Grounds Hardscape Upkeep Work Order
Work date: 06/18/2026 | Crew lead: Neil Delgado | Site contact: Nadia Kim

## Inspection and work scope
Raymond Haddad's inspection on 06/17/2026 identified a 4-ft sidewalk section near the east gate with a 1.5-in vertical trip edge, a clogged fountain basin drain, and weeds in the granite joints along the north burial-site path. Field measurements recorded the east-gate sidewalk as 5 ft wide. The sidewalk is 5 in wide and runs beside an accessible route.

## Work steps
- Close the east-gate sidewalk section with cones and barricades before removing or resetting pavers.
- Reset the raised pavers to create a flush walking surface, then sweep polymeric joint sand into the joints and compact according to the product label.
- Remove leaves and sediment from the fountain basin; clear the drain with hand tools and collect debris for disposal.
- Pull weeds from the north path joints by hand and refill open joints with matching granite screenings.
- Reopen the sidewalk after inspection confirms the walking surface is flush and the work area is clean.
- Record the sidewalk repair as complete after confirming the accessible route has a maximum running slope of 1:12.

## Materials and equipment
| Item | Quantity | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Replacement pavers, 4 in x 8 in | 12 | East-gate sidewalk |
| Polymeric joint sand | 1 bag, 50 lb | Sidewalk joints |
| Granite screenings | 2 bags, 40 lb each | North burial-site path |
| Cones and barricades | 6 | Work-zone protection |

## Closeout
Neil will photograph the repaired sidewalk and cleaned fountain, note any damaged pavers requiring replacement, and send the work log to Nadia by 4:00 PM on 06/18/2026. Keep the east-gate sidewalk closed until the replacement pavers are set and the polymeric sand has cured for 24 hours.

errors.quote: The sidewalk is 5 in wide and runs beside an accessible route.
errors.explanation: The inspection notes record the east-gate sidewalk as 5 ft wide, so the stated 5-in width directly contradicts the measurement elsewhere in the document.
errors.fix: The sidewalk is 5 ft wide and runs beside an accessible route.

errors.quote: Record the sidewalk repair as complete after confirming the accessible route has a maximum running slope of 1:12.
errors.explanation: This closeout step checks only running slope and omits verification of cross slope. The accessible route needs both measurements checked; the running-slope check alone does not establish an accessible walking surface.
errors.fix: Record the sidewalk repair as complete after confirming the accessible route has a maximum running slope of 1:12 and a maximum cross slope of 1:48.
